name: Sarson Ka Saag
description: A classic Punjabi winter dish of mustard greens slowly cooked with spinach, aromatics and a rustic maize-flour finish.
ingredients: 750 g mustard greens (sarson), cleaned and chopped
method: Wash the mustard greens and spinach thoroughly and chop them roughly.
Cook the greens with green chilies, ginger, garlic, salt and a small splash of water until very soft.
Mash or blend the cooked greens to a coarse texture.
Stir in maize flour and simmer on low heat until the saag thickens.
Fry onion and a little garlic in ghee until golden, then pour the tempering over the saag.
Serve hot with makki di roti and a small spoon of ghee.
